failure_reason: Data format incompatibility - ParquetDataCatalog cannot load data
errors_encountered: ParquetDataCatalog.order_book_deltas() returned 0 records despite 7.1M rows in parquet file
ParquetDataCatalog.trade_ticks() returned 0 records despite 291K rows in parquet file
Data format mismatch: Parquet files contain raw CSV-like data, not Nautilus native objects
root_cause: The data recording script saved data in CSV-like parquet format instead of Nautilus native format. The ParquetDataCatalog expects Nautilus-serialized objects (OrderBookDelta, TradeTick) but found simple columnar data (action, price, side, size, timestamp).
resolution_required: Either: (1) Use Nautilus native data recording API, or (2) Convert existing parquet files to Nautilus format, or (3) Modify backtest script to load raw parquet data directly
